title: Duplicate Candidate Verification
description: Human verification of AI-identified duplicate project candidates. A candidate is never a confirmed duplicate until verified.

steps.title: Compare the candidate pair
steps.guidance: Open both projects side by side. Compare titles, locations, categories, agencies, sanction dates and costs using the similarity evidence.
steps.evidence_hint: Similar-projects panel: text similarity, distance (km), cost similarity

steps.title: Verify locations on the map
steps.guidance: Check whether the two works are genuinely at the same site or are distinct works at nearby locations (e.g. two wards, phases).

steps.title: Check sanction and funding records
steps.guidance: If both projects funded the same physical work, identify which sanction is the original and whether double funding occurred.
steps.evidence_hint: Sanction records, payments on each project

steps.title: Record verified / not-duplicate with reasons
steps.guidance: Record the human determination. Legitimate look-alikes (phases, adjacent wards) must be explicitly marked not-duplicate so future reviews inherit the finding.
